notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three. The sources are a lookout-list entry, an OpenStreetMap node (name, coordinates, tagged as a tower, ele 514 m; the elevation is not in facts because there is no elevation key), and a Forest Service history that names Padus only as a town. Two WebSearch calls and a cache scan found no build date, design, staffing, or removal record for this tower. The story is short on purpose (about 75 words; the guide's thin-source length is about 120, but padding would invent content). Brief elevation_m 514.0 matches the OSM ele tag. A search summary said most Nicolet towers were removed in 1973, but the Forest Service PDF timed out (504) and the claim is not specific to Padus, so it is not used. Access and visit facts were left out for lack of source. Searches: 2 WebSearch, about 3 page reads.
